content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Pensacola

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and degree requirements for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your qualifications before you enroll in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Over multiple sessions, you'll master PMBOK® Guide principles, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and real-world application. Our active certified practitioners deliver all instruction online—fit learning around your Pensacola work schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application to PMI with your contact hours documented. Pay PMI's examination fee and await approval of your eligibility. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and required supporting materials.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and strategy sessions—to reinforce course content. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. You may test at any authorized center; many Pensacola professionals test locally.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, or completing project-management work. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting proof of PDUs and renewal fees to PMI.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
